timeline.text: Welcome to Carrying a Team Project. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel like this project depends entirely on me.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep picking up what other people are not doing.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am frustrated that the weight is not shared.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice myself keeping score of who is doing what.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tired from carrying this alone.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want someone to notice how much I am doing.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is afraid to speak up about it.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel resentful.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is starting to feel like too much.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can name what I am carrying, even to myself.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not have to fix every gap I see.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask for what I need instead of absorbing it silently.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let go of keeping score for a moment.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release some of this weight.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: It is okay to do my part and stop there.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can speak up without it being a conflict.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can protect my energy while still contributing.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I do not have to carry this by myself.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to ask for real support.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My effort is valid even if others notice it late.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to set a clear boundary.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on my part and let others own theirs.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel lighter as I let go of the rest.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can finish this without losing myself in it.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am capable, and I am also allowed help.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can do good work without carrying everyone.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to set this weight down.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
